description: This file defines a PHP class implementing an API endpoint for validating video URLs within the OrangeHRM Buzz module. It handles GET requests to validate a provided URL, returning the URL, its embedded version, and validation status.

classes.name: BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI
classes.description: Handles API requests for validating video URLs, providing validation result, the URL itself, and embedded URL if valid.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Processes GET request to validate a video URL, returning validation status, URL, and embedded URL.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method.

methods.name: getVideoValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the video URL parameter.
